excerpt: JMSC6203 Post-production in documentary [Section 2A, 2025] JMSC6202 Audience design in documentary [Section 2A, 2025] Course Description Audience Design in Documentary teaches students how to build audience awareness and covers creative development, research access, budgeting, funding sources, legal considerations, production management, collaboration, impact planning, and distribution. The course connects artistic choices with industry realities, preparing students to act as producers in professional documentary settings. Course Policy and Attendance Attendance throughout each lecture is mandatory. Missing more than two classes without prior notice may lead to removal from the course. Plagiarism is strictly forbidden in professional organizations and this course as well. Students who cheat or submit others’ work as their own will fail the course. Communications The main method of communication for the course will be email. Students can schedule one-on-one meetings with the lecturer during official office hours. Office hours are by appointment only and are available on a first-come, first-served basis.
